name: Tristia: Restore
original_name: トリスティア：リストア
source:
Happening in parallel to Tristia:legacy, the story of Tristia:restore follows the genius inventor girl Nanoca Flanka, granddaughter of the legendary inventor and crafter Prospero Flanka, as she is working to revitalize the floundering marine city of Tristia alongside her trusty companions! But this game focuses more on the day to day of running the shop: She has some major crafting projects to complete, but all the while, new orders for smaller objects are coming in for her to complete!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244150/Tristiarestore/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事与《Tristia:legacy》平行展开，讲述天才发明少女Nanoca Flanka与值得信赖的伙伴们一同振兴海滨城市Tristia的经历。Nanoca是传奇发明家兼工匠Prospero Flanka的孙女。不过，本作更着重描绘她日常经营店铺的生活：她不仅要完成几项大型制作，还得不断处理新的小型订单！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244150/Tristiarestore/]Steam[/url]]
